messages.subject: Summarizing and Comparing Model Fit Statistics
messages.subject_clean: Summarizing and Comparing Model Fit Statistics
messages.body_plain:
Hello, I am fairly new to R but do have some experience with Mplus. I am currently trying to use MplusAutomation to run a number of multilevel CFAs, and compare/summarize the results. I have been able to get the program to run each of the models separately without any issue.

I am however having trouble with using the program to read each output file and generate a summary/comparison of the fit statistics. I am starting small with only 3 separate models until I can figure this out. I have tried the compareModels and showSummaryTable commands but get various error messages in the process. Any sample syntax or guidance on this would be greatly appreciated. Thanks for your time.

Justin
